guide.title: Beading Guide
guide.s1: 1. Tap a material card to add a bead; 2. Drag beads to reorder, drag out of the ring to delete; 3. Tap Finish Design to save and get a quote.
guide.s2: Free mode by default. Switch tags for pro modes: By Wrist auto-counts beads; By Count adjusts manually; Mix & Match arranges multiple beads.
guide.s3: Wrap a tape around the widest part of your four knuckles; or measure the inner diameter of a bracelet that fits.
guide.s4: The capsule above shows live status: too tight / snug / fit / loose / too loose. Three ease levels with Comfortable as default.
guide.s5: 6x7mm + 6x8mm + 6x9mm is fine: beads are summed one by one to converge the inner circumference and fit.
guide.s6: The elastic knot sits at the top knot marker (hideable); cord includes knot allowance. Pendants/tassels are optional—skip freely; if added they render and drag on the bracelet. Metal spacers count as beads.
guide.s7: Price changes with every tweak. Find works under My Designs. Tap Use This Design in the gallery to replicate.
